description: Reads the account's plan and what it has used of each monthly quota: leads captured, emails sent, AI messages, plus how many websites and widgets exist against the plan's limits. Leads are counted over the billing period and everything else over the calendar month (UTC). `plan` is null when no plan is active. Answers "what is my limit" and "how close am I to the cap". Changes nothing.
name: read_plan_usage
title: Read plan usage
